card.name: Efficacy wording in reduced-effect warnings
card.fires_on: The words efficacy, effectiveness or effectively (including the end of Effic-acy) right after words like decrease, reduce or reduced. Seen in drug interaction sections.

modes.label: Reduced efficacy
modes.description: The word efficacy or its split ending follows decrease or reduced in interaction text.
modes.example: which may result in reduced<< efficacy>> for these concomitant medications

modes.label: Reduced effectiveness
modes.description: The word effectiveness follows reduce the, naming a brand drug that may work less well.
modes.example: which may reduce the<< effectiveness>> of OJEMDA

modes.label: Efficacy in headings
modes.description: The end of Efficacy inside a heading about interactions that decrease it.
modes.example: 7.2 Drug Interactions that Decrease the Effic<<acy>> of Ros
